summary: legal checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta and full launch. Keep SearchWoot private. Woot evidence confirms API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, affiliate-link, or advertise returned data; public terms restrict commercial/public reuse. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, including 20 banner/accept/reject/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only if it adds no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims. Human counsel is required before any rights exception, public data use, affiliate expansion, or advertising use.

Progress: source-rights evidence is documented but confirms access only; data-flow and consent/analytics evidence are partial; logs, vendors, and incident handling remain unevidenced. No task is closed. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow table, deployed consent capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field and retention inventory, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/request procedures.
